control_notes: b8seed-nomask (attach without the context's mask) did not fire on mask-routing and main-exit-signal: musl's start() sets every new thread's mask with rt_sigprocmask, which applies it on the thread anyway. It fires on thread-probe signal-unblocked-context (b8seed2-nomask), whose contexts never set a mask; the musl-thread path fires under b8seed2-noprocmask (a further context's rt_sigprocmask not applied to its thread).

b8seed3-domain-setuid-threads passed against musl's own __synccall because that mode's computing thread read a clock in its loop, and every entry into the dispatcher takes signals; the mode now spins without any call, and b8seed-debug-muslsynccall-setuid-threads is that version's control.
